title: MetaMarS: metatranscriptomics of marine sediment bacterial communities
description:
Scripts accompanying Guden, R. M., Haegeman, A., Ruttink, T., Moens, T. and Derycke, S. (2024) Nematodes alter the taxonomic and functional profiles of benthic bacterial communities: a metatranscriptomic approach. Molecular Ecology 33: e17331. They cover read preprocessing (FastQC, cutadapt, PEAR, SortMeRNA), taxonomic classification of reads (Kraken2) and taxonomy count tables, COG-based functional analysis, and KEGG enzyme and MinPath pathway analysis.

Developed at Ghent University and ILVO (Belgium), building on the metatranscriptomics pipeline by A. Haegeman (gitlab.com/ahaegeman/Metatranscriptomics_marine_sediment).
